rule.name: The Performance Eternal
rule.text:
**Cast the Performers.** At the start of your first Command phase, select three different friendly Emperor's Children INFANTRY or MOUNTED units on the battlefield. Designate one **the Duellist**, one **the Dancer** and one **the Executioner**. Select one role to hold **the Spotlight**. Each role can earn no more than one **Ovation** per battle round. **Ovation triggers:** - **Duellist:** During the Fight phase, its melee attacks inflict damage on a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, and the Duellist survives until the end of that phase. If the enemy army has no surviving CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE units, damaging any enemy unit in melee qualifies. - **Dancer:** In your Charge phase, it completes a Charge move ending within range of an objective marker you did **not** control immediately before it began that Charge move. - **Executioner:** Its attacks destroy an enemy unit. **Spotlight:** Immediately after a Performer earns an Ovation, its role takes the Spotlight until another role earns it or a rule transfers it. **Replacement:** At the start of your next Command phase after a Performer is destroyed or permanently leaves the battlefield, assign its role to an eligible unit without a role, if possible. The role retains its Spotlight and Ovations, even while vacant. A returning Performer loses its role if replaced. **The Three Acts:** Your army begins in **Act I**. At the end of a battle round, check for advancement. The new Act replaces the previous Act at the start of the next battle round. **Act I — The Opening Flourish**
**Army:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in friendly Emperor's Children units.
**Spotlight:** Re-roll Charge rolls for the Performer holding the Spotlight.
**Advance to Act II:** During the same battle round, two **different** Performer roles each earned an Ovation. **Act II — The Rapturous Climax**
**Army:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in friendly Emperor's Children units during a turn in which their unit made a Charge move.
**Spotlight:** The Performer holding the Spotlight has FIGHTS FIRST.
**Advance to Act III:** Since entering Act II, all **three** roles have earned at least one Ovation, and the Performer holding the Spotlight destroyed at least one enemy unit with its attacks while Act II was active. **Act III — The Grand Finale**
**Army:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 of melee weapons equipped by models in friendly Emperor's Children units, **excluding weapons with EXTRA ATTACKS**.
**Spotlight:** Once per battle round, immediately after the Performer holding the Spotlight finishes fighting, if that unit is still on the battlefield, it can make a Pile-in move of up to 6" and **fight one additional time**, provided it is then eligible to fight.

enhancements.name: Master of the Marquee
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER only, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, at the start of a phase, if the bearer's unit is a Performer, you can transfer the Spotlight to one other surviving Performer within 12" of the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Crimson Masque
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER only, excluding EPIC HEROES. While the bearer's unit holds the Spotlight, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have PRECISION.

enhancements.name: Understudy's Mask
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER only, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle, when a Performer is destroyed, if the bearer's unit is on the battlefield, is eligible to become a Performer and currently has no Performer role, it immediately assumes the destroyed unit's role, inheriting its Spotlight and recorded Ovations.

enhancements.name: Rapturous Applause
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER only, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, after the bearer's Performer unit earns an Ovation, select one enemy unit within 6" of it. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

stratagems.name: A Perfect Entrance
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just before a Performer from your army makes a Charge roll.
stratagems.target: That Performer.
stratagems.effect: Add 2 to the Charge roll.

stratagems.name: Steal the Spotlight
stratagems.when: At the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One surviving Performer from your army.
stratagems.effect: That Performer's role takes the Spotlight. It does not earn an Ovation.

stratagems.name: Stolen Ovation
stratagems.when: After an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one of your Performers fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: That Performer, provided its role has not earned an Ovation this battle round.
stratagems.effect: That role earns one Ovation.

stratagems.name: Beneath the Footlights
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit selects its targets.
stratagems.target: The friendly Performer holding the Spotlight, if selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks targeting your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: No One Leaves the Stage
stratagems.when: At the end of the Fight phase, after a Performer from your army inflicted damage on an enemy unit with its melee attacks this phase.
stratagems.target: That Performer and one such surviving enemy unit within Engagement Range.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your opponent's next Movement phase, each time that enemy unit is selected to Fall Back it must first pass a Leadership test. If it fails, it cannot Fall Back this phase.

stratagems.name: The Final Bow
stratagems.when: Fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit finishes its melee attacks and destroys the Performer holding the Spotlight, before removing its last model.
stratagems.target: That destroyed Performer, **only if it has not fought this phase**.
stratagems.effect: The Performer can fight before being removed. It cannot use The Grand Finale's additional fight.

rule.name: Whispers of the Dark Prince
rule.text:
**Offering temptation.** At the start of each phase, you can offer a Seduction to one enemy unit within 12" of a friendly Emperor's Children unit. Choose a Seduction if it has none. It keeps that Seduction until it returns to Level 0.

The enemy player can accept to increase the unit's Level by one, to a maximum of III, or roll one D6 to resist. A roll of **3+** resists Level I, **5+** resists Level II and **6+** resists Level III.

- **Successful resistance — Spurned:** Reduce its Level by one, to a minimum of 0. Subtract 1 from the next Battle-shock test that unit takes before the end of the battle round.
- **Failed resistance:** Increase its Seduction Level as though it had accepted.
- **Reaching Level III:** The unit immediately takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test fails, it suffers **3 mortal wounds**.

**Levels and duration:** Apply the Boons and Prices of its current Level and all lower Levels. Use only the highest active Feel No Pain value and Rapture of Speed Move bonus.

**Deepening Temptation.** Subtract 1 from the resistance roll when you offer a Seduction to an already Seduced unit in your Command phase.

**Level III Price exemption:** Titanic and Epic Hero models ignore only the **Level III Price**.

**Rapture of Speed**
- **I — Boon:** Add 2" to the unit's Move characteristic. **Price:** It cannot Fall Back.
- **II — Boon:** It can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. **Price:** Subtract 1 from Hit rolls for its ranged attacks.
- **III — Boon:** Increase its Move bonus to **+4" total** and it can re-roll Charge rolls. **Price:** Before it declares a charge, it takes a Leadership test. On a failure, the Emperor's Children player chooses a legal charge target. If none is eligible, the unit cannot charge.

**Exquisite Agony**
- **I — Boon:** Feel No Pain 6+. **Price:** Worsen Leadership by 1.
- **II — Boon:** Improve Feel No Pain to 5+. **Price:** Subtract 1 from Battle-shock test results.
- **III — Boon:** Improve Feel No Pain to 4+. **Price:** At the start of each battle round, this unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

**Ecstatic Violence**
- **I — Boon:** Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for melee attacks. **Price:** When declaring a charge or selecting targets for melee attacks, it must include the closest eligible enemy unit where possible.
- **II — Boon:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons, excluding EXTRA ATTACKS. **Price:** Subtract 1 from saving throws made for models in the unit.
- **III — Boon:** Its melee weapons gain LETHAL HITS and add 1 to their Strength characteristic. **Price:** The unit has FIGHTS LAST.

**Perfect Sensation**
- **I — Boon:** Its ranged weapons have IGNORES COVER. **Price:** Its ranged weapons must target the closest eligible enemy unit wherever possible.
- **II — Boon:** Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of its ranged weapons by 1 (to a best of 2+). **Price:** Subtract 2" from its Move characteristic.
- **III — Boon:** Its ranged weapons gain SUSTAINED HITS 1. **Price:** The unit has Objective Control 0 and cannot Advance.

**Whispered Secrets**
- **I — Boon:** Once per phase, re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw made for the unit. **Price:** Worsen its Leadership by 1.
- **II — Boon:** Its attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+. **Price:** While Seduced at Level II or III, the unit cannot be targeted by its controlling player's Stratagems.
- **III — Boon:** Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks. **Price:** After this unit finishes shooting or fighting, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

**Thrall of the Dark Prince**
- **I — Boon:** Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks. **Price:** Worsen its Leadership by 1.
- **II — Boon:** Improve the AP characteristic of its weapons by 1. **Price:** The Emperor's Children player chooses the unit's legal targets whenever it shoots or declares a charge.
- **III — Boon:** Feel No Pain 5+. **Price:** Possession.

**Possession**

At the start of **your** Movement, Shooting or Fight phase, select one enemy unit Seduced by Thrall of the Dark Prince at Level III within 12" of one of your Emperor's Children units. Its controlling player makes a Leadership test for it.
- **Passed:** Reduce its Seduction to Level II.
- **Failed:** Control the unit for one immediate action. In Movement, make one Normal move. In Shooting, shoot once. In the Fight phase, make a Charge move of up to 6" without rolling, then fight once if eligible. For target selection during that action, treat its original army as enemy and your Emperor's Children units as friendly. Use the possessed unit's characteristics and abilities. Your Stratagems and army rules do not apply.

**Possession limitations:** Possession cannot force a disembark, activate a faction rule, spend CP or change mission ownership or scoring. A unit can be possessed only once per battle round. After a failed test, reset its Level to 0 once the action is resolved or if it cannot act.

enhancements.name: The Silver Tongue
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. When your army offers a Seduction to an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer, subtract 1 from that unit's resistance roll. This cannot make the roll automatically fail.

enhancements.name: A Thousand Promises
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, after an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer successfully resists a Seduction, you can choose for it to retain its current Level rather than decrease it by one.

enhancements.name: Mirror of Forbidden Truths
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Each time an enemy unit within 6" of the bearer accepts a Seduction or fails its resistance roll, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Favoured Tempter
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, when you select an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer for a Thrall of the Dark Prince possession test, subtract 1 from its Leadership test result.

stratagems.name: The Sweetest Lie
stratagems.when: Immediately after an enemy unit successfully resists one of your Seduction offers.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit, provided it is within 12" of a friendly Emperor's Children CHARACTER.
stratagems.effect: Its controlling player must re-roll that resistance roll.

stratagems.name: A Taste of Ruin
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: That friendly unit and one enemy unit with Seduction Level II or III it can legally target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for your unit's attacks targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Withering Withdrawal
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit with Seduction Level I or higher is selected to make a Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit, within 12" of a friendly Emperor's Children unit.
stratagems.effect: The enemy unit must pass a Leadership test before making that move. On a failure, it cannot Fall Back this phase.

stratagems.name: The Price Comes Due
stratagems.when: At the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One enemy unit with Seduction Level II or III within 12" of a friendly Emperor's Children unit.
stratagems.effect: That unit takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. If failed, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Drowned in Delight
stratagems.when: After an enemy unit with Seduction Level II or III destroys one of your Emperor's Children units.
stratagems.target: That enemy unit and one surviving friendly Emperor's Children unit within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: The enemy unit immediately takes a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. If that test fails, the friendly selected unit can make a Normal move of up to 3" if it is unengaged.

stratagems.name: One Final Indulgence
stratagems.when: At the start of your Movement, Shooting or Fight phase, before attempting possession.
stratagems.target: One enemy unit with Seduction Level III within 12" of a friendly Emperor's Children CHARACTER.
stratagems.effect: If its Seduction is **Thrall of the Dark Prince**, subtract 2 from the Leadership test result for its possession attempt this phase. Otherwise, the target suffers 3 mortal wounds and its Seduction decreases to Level II.

rule.name: The Sovereign's Will
rule.text:
**Issue Doctrines.** Once per battle round, **at the start of any phase**, each friendly Emperor's Children CHARACTER with **SUBLIME STRATEGIST** on the battlefield can issue one Doctrine to one friendly **non-Daemon Emperor's Children** unit within **12"**. Fulgrim can issue **two Doctrines per battle round**, to two different eligible units; these can be issued in the same or different phases.

The recipient immediately suffers **1 mortal wound**, or **3 mortal wounds** if Stupefied. If it survives, it gains the chosen Doctrine **until the start of your next Command phase**. A new Doctrine replaces any existing Doctrine.

**The four Doctrines:**

- **Decree of Slaughter:** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have **LETHAL HITS** and **SUSTAINED HITS 1**.
- **Decree of Iron Loyalty:** Models in this unit have a **5+ invulnerable save**.
- **Decree of Exaltation:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit, **excluding EXTRA ATTACKS**.
- **Decree of the Perfect Hunt:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit. The unit can declare a charge after Advancing.

enhancements.name: Sceptre of Edicts
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER with SUBLIME STRATEGIST, excluding EPIC HEROES. The bearer can issue Doctrines to eligible units within **18"** instead of 12".

enhancements.name: Purest Allegiance
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER with SUBLIME STRATEGIST, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, the first unit to receive a Doctrine from the bearer suffers **no mortal wounds** from its issuance.

enhancements.name: Master of Protocol
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER with SUBLIME STRATEGIST, excluding EPIC HEROES. The bearer can issue **two** Doctrines per battle round to **different** units instead of one.

enhancements.name: The Dictator's Writ
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. While the bearer's unit has a Doctrine, its melee weapons have **PRECISION**.

stratagems.name: By Royal Command
stratagems.when: At the start of any phase, immediately after one of your SUBLIME STRATEGIST CHARACTERS issues a Doctrine.
stratagems.target: The unit that received that Doctrine.
stratagems.effect: The unit suffers 1 additional mortal wound, or 3 if Stupefied. If it survives, it gains a second, different Doctrine until the first expires. A unit can benefit from this Stratagem only once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Maintain Formation
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of one of your unengaged units with a Doctrine.
stratagems.target: That friendly unit.
stratagems.effect: It can make a Normal move of up to **3"**.

stratagems.name: Iron Mandate
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets for its attacks.
stratagems.target: One friendly Emperor's Children unit with a Doctrine selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until that enemy unit finishes attacking, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of attacks targeting your unit (minimum 1).

stratagems.name: Of One Mind
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, immediately after a friendly unit with a Doctrine completes a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One other unengaged friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit within 6" of it.
stratagems.effect: The selected unit can immediately declare a charge if otherwise eligible.

stratagems.name: Reassignment of Honour
stratagems.when: Immediately after a friendly Emperor's Children unit with a Doctrine is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One other eligible friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children unit within 6" of the destroyed unit immediately before its last model was removed.
stratagems.effect: The new unit suffers **1 mortal wound (3 if Stupefied)**. If it survives, it gains the destroyed unit's Doctrine until its original expiry. It replaces an existing Doctrine if present.

stratagems.name: A Worthy Sacrifice
stratagems.when: Fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit finishes its melee attacks that destroyed one of your units with a Doctrine, before its last model is removed.
stratagems.target: That destroyed unit, if it has **not already fought this phase**.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6. On a 4+, it can fight before being removed.

rule.name: Carefully Measured Excess
rule.text:
Once per battle round, each friendly **non-Daemon Emperor's Children INFANTRY, MOUNTED or BEAST** unit can select **one** Combat Drug when the appropriate trigger below occurs. It takes effect immediately.

- **Predator's Ichor:** When selected to shoot or fight, add **1** to the Strength characteristic of its ranged or melee weapons, respectively, until the end of that phase.
- **Caustic Ecstasy:** When selected to shoot or fight, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of its ranged or melee weapons, respectively, by **1** until the end of that phase.
- **Quicksilver Adrenaline:** When selected to Advance or immediately before making a Charge roll, add **1** to its Advance and Charge rolls until the end of that turn.
- **Reflex Narcotics:** When selected as the target of an enemy unit's melee attacks, subtract **1** from Hit rolls for those attacks until that enemy unit has finished attacking.

enhancements.name: Master Chemist
enhancements.text: Non-DAEMON Emperor's Children CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, when the bearer's unit selects a Combat Drug, it can select **two different** Combat Drugs instead. Both drugs must meet their triggers.

enhancements.name: Glassed Veins
enhancements.text: Non-DAEMON Emperor's Children CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Re-roll one Leadership test made by the bearer's unit to cease being Stupefied per battle round.

stratagems.name: Second Dose
stratagems.when: When a friendly unit from this detachment selects a Combat Drug, before resolving its effect.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: It can select **one additional, different Combat Drug** for which it currently meets the normal trigger. A unit can have at most **two** Combat Drugs selected in a battle round, including via Master Chemist.

stratagems.name: Surgical Appetite
stratagems.when: Fight phase, immediately after a friendly unit that selected a Combat Drug this battle round destroys an enemy unit with its melee attacks.
stratagems.target: That attacking unit.
stratagems.effect: Restore D3 wounds to that unit, including returning eligible non-Character models up to Starting Strength.

stratagems.name: Preternatural Reflexes
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit selects its targets.
stratagems.target: One friendly unit that selected a Combat Drug this battle round and was chosen as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the enemy unit finishes attacking, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for its ranged attacks targeting your unit.

rule.name: Gilded Bulwark
rule.text:
Each time a saving throw is made for a friendly **EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model with the TERMINATOR keyword**, re-roll a result of **1**.

**Gilded Elite units** are friendly **EXCRUCIATOR TERMINATORS, PHOENIX GUARD TERMINATORS, FLAWLESS BLADES, DISSONANT COLOSSI and NOISE MARINES**, including Attached units containing one of those Bodyguard units.

enhancements.name: Gilded Aegis
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TERMINATOR CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle, after an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as the target of its attacks, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of attacks targeting that unit until the attacking unit finishes attacking (minimum 1).

enhancements.name: Exultant Command
enhancements.text: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN TERMINATOR CHARACTER, excluding EPIC HEROES. Once per battle round, when a friendly Gilded Elite unit within 6" of the bearer's unit is selected to fight, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its melee attacks until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: We Shall Not Yield
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects targets.
stratagems.target: One friendly Gilded Elite unit selected as a target. **You can target that unit with this Stratagem even if it is Battle-shocked.**
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit finishes attacking, models in the selected unit have **Feel No Pain 5+**.

stratagems.name: Gilded Advance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when one friendly Gilded Elite unit is selected to make a Normal move.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of that move, add **3"** to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.

stratagems.name: Unmatched Prowess
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Gilded Elite unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add **1** to Wound rolls for its melee attacks against **CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE** units.

armyRules.Thrill Seekers:
**Surrender to Excess**

Each time a friendly Emperor's Children unit is selected to move, shoot or fight, or is selected as the target of an enemy unit's attacks, you can choose for it to become **Stupefied**. Decide before the move, fight or attacks are resolved.

**Stupefied**

While an Emperor's Children unit is Stupefied:

- Each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of **1**. If the target is within **12"** of the attacking model, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
- That unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge after Advancing or Falling Back. If it Advanced or Fell Back this turn, an attack it makes with a ranged weapon scores a Hit **only on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+**.
- When it shoots, each ranged weapon must target the closest enemy unit eligible for that weapon, measured from the attacking model. If two eligible enemy units are equally close, its controlling player chooses between them. A charge declared by the unit must include the closest eligible enemy unit, if one exists.
- Models in the unit have **Feel No Pain 5+**.
- Models in the unit have **Objective Control 0**.
- **Worsen its Leadership characteristic by 1**.
- It cannot be selected as the target of friendly Stratagems, unless the Stratagem explicitly allows targeting a Stupefied unit.

**Fading Euphoria**

At the Battle-shock step of **your Command phase**, each friendly Stupefied unit takes a Leadership test separate from any Battle-shock test. On a pass, it ceases to be Stupefied.

**Pain Brings Clarity**

When a friendly Emperor's Children unit or an enemy unit within **6"** of a friendly Stupefied Emperor's Children unit is destroyed, or when an enemy unit within **6"** of it fails a Battle-shock test, that Stupefied unit can immediately take a Leadership test. On a pass, it ceases to be Stupefied. Measure distances to a destroyed unit immediately before its last model is removed.

A unit **cannot** cease being Stupefied during the same phase in which it became Stupefied.
armyRules.Manifestation:
**Summoning Pool**

Legions of Excess units begin the battle in your **Summoning Pool**. A summoned Attached unit uses **one Ritual**, shares **one Manifestation total** and becomes Debound as one unit.

**Manifestation Capacity**

Greater Daemons have a maximum of **9 points**. Lesser Daemons have a maximum of **6 points**.

**Initial Manifestation**

After paying the Ritual costs and resolving its risks, set up the summoned unit wholly within **24"** of its Psyker and more than **8"** horizontally from all enemy models. Roll for its initial Manifestation using the applicable distance band, up to its capacity.

| Placed wholly within | Initial Manifestation |
|---|---|
| **6"** | **D3+3** |
| **12"** (but not wholly within 6") | **D3+1** |
| **24"** (but not wholly within 12") | **D3** |

**Feeding on Suffering**

Each time a friendly or enemy non-Daemon unit within **6"** of a Legions of Excess unit on the battlefield is destroyed or fails a Battle-shock test, that Legions of Excess unit gains **1 Manifestation point**, up to its capacity. Measure a destroyed unit's range immediately before removing its last model.

**Fading Presence**

At the end of **each phase in your turn**, after any applicable gains that phase, every Legions of Excess unit on the battlefield with Manifestation loses **1 point**. **Furies of Slaanesh** lose this point only at the end of **your Fight phase**.

**Debound**

If a unit has **0 Manifestation points**, it immediately becomes **Debound**. Return its surviving models to the Summoning Pool with their remaining wounds. Debound does not count as destruction.
armyRules.Summoning Rituals:
**Lesser Daemonic Ritual — Psychic Level 1**

At the start of a phase in **your turn**, one friendly **non-Daemon Psyker** unit that is not Battle-shocked can attempt a Lesser Daemonic Ritual, spending **1** of its available psychic-level allowance for the battle round. Roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a **1**, the caster's unit becomes Battle-shocked; regardless of the roll, complete the Ritual if legal. Select a **Lesser** Legions of Excess unit in your Summoning Pool and set it up using the Initial Manifestation rules.

A Psyker can repeat this Ritual while it has psychic-level allowance remaining. A friendly Daemon Psyker can use it only to summon Furies of Slaanesh.

A summoned Lesser unit can charge that turn if eligible.

**Greater Daemonic Ritual**

At the start of **your Charge phase**, select one friendly **non-Daemon Psyker** that **has not performed any summoning Ritual earlier this turn**. Select one Greater Daemon still in your Summoning Pool, then pay **one** of these costs:

- **Sacrifice:** Destroy one **other** friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children INFANTRY unit within **6"** of the summoning Psyker.
- **Essence:** Select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within **6"** of the summoning Psyker with **at least 3 Manifestation points**. Remove **3 Manifestation points** from it as payment.

Resolve the cost, then set up the Greater Daemon using the Initial Manifestation rules.

A Greater Ritual spends no psychic-level allowance. Each eligible Psyker can perform its own Greater Ritual. A summoned Greater Daemon can charge that phase if eligible.

detachmentRules.name: Never Still
detachmentRules.text: *Mercurial units* means friendly Emperor's Children Infantry, MOUNTED and BEAST units. Add **1** to Advance and Charge rolls made for Mercurial units. Once per battle round, after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within **8"** of an unengaged Mercurial unit, you can select one such friendly unit to make a Normal move of **D3+3"**.

detachmentRules.name: Daemonic Empowerment
detachmentRules.text:
A friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children unit within 6" of one or more friendly Legions of Excess units is Empowered. A Legions of Excess unit within 6" of one or more friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children units is Empowered.

**EC units:** While a friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children unit is Empowered, once per battle round when it takes a Leadership test to cease being Stupefied, it can re-roll that test. If that test ends Stupefied, the unit heals D3 wounds.

**Legions units:** While Empowered, add 1 to this unit's Advance and Charge rolls.

**Mortal Anchors:** When a summoned Legions of Excess unit is Empowered at the end of the phase in which it was summoned, it skips that phase's Fading Presence loss.

detachmentRules.name: Allied Allowance
detachmentRules.text: You can include up to 500 points of Legions of Excess.

detachmentRules.name: A Thousand Willing Voices
detachmentRules.text: A friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Character without Psyker can perform **one Lesser Daemonic Ritual per turn** as though it were Psyker LEVEL 1, solely for that ritual. A friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Psyker Character can perform **one additional Lesser Daemonic Ritual per turn** without spending its psychic-level allowance.

enhancements.name: Awakening Chimes [Upgrade]
enhancements.text: Threnody Dreadnought only. Once per battle, at the start of a phase, the model can temporarily suspend **Interred in Rapture** and the effects of Stupefied until the end of that phase. If it was Stupefied when this was activated, it resumes that state when the phase ends unless another rule ended it. It cannot use Surrender to Excess to become newly Stupefied during this suspended period.

enhancements.name: Consecrated Sacrificial Knife
enhancements.text: Non-Daemon Emperor's Children Psyker Character. Once per battle, when determining a Greater Daemon's initial Manifestation after the bearer summons it, roll the D3 component twice and choose one result, then add the summoning-distance modifier. This cannot combine with Summoning Circle on the same roll.

stratagems.name: Dark Apparitions
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One unengaged friendly Legions of Excess unit, excluding Greater Daemons.
stratagems.effect: That unit becomes Debound. The next time it is summoned, it can be set up more than **5"** horizontally from all enemy models instead of the normal 8".

stratagems.name: Clinical Preparation
stratagems.when: Immediately before a friendly non-Daemon Emperor's Children Infantry unit within 6" of a friendly Chirurgeon makes a Leadership test to cease being Stupefied or takes a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.target: One friendly Chirurgeon within 6" of that Infantry unit.
stratagems.effect: The Infantry unit can re-roll the Leadership test to cease being Stupefied, or automatically passes the Battle-shock test, as applicable.

stratagems.name: Feed the Furnace
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: That friendly Vehicle unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of that phase, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks targeting Battle-shocked enemy units.

stratagems.name: Revel in the Wreckage
stratagems.when: After a friendly Emperor's Children Vehicle unit destroys an enemy unit with its attacks.
stratagems.target: That friendly Vehicle unit.
stratagems.effect: Its model heals **D3+3** wounds.

stratagems.name: Summoning Circle
stratagems.when: When a friendly non-Daemon EC Character begins a summoning ritual.
stratagems.target: That Character and one other friendly non-Daemon EC Character within 6" that has not performed a ritual this turn.
stratagems.effect: Both count as having performed a ritual this turn. Roll the D3 component of initial Manifestation twice and choose one result, then add the summoning-distance modifier. This cannot combine with Consecrated Sacrificial Knife on the same roll.

rules.221a-d76e-5760-c47b: Sonic blaster, twin sonic blaster, screamer pistol, combi-weapon - sonic, blastmaster, dreadblaster, requiem cannon, cathedral annihilator, Discord cannon, sonic balespewer, sonic destructor, cathedral sonic immolator, resonance cannon, shriek cannon, grand vox array, Death Scream, The Eighth's Refrain, First Scream. All profiles qualify.
rules.694d-e320-8cc1-12bf: Once per battle round, each friendly EC or Legions of Excess Psyker unit can use one Level 1 psychic power without consuming its psychic-level allowance.
rules.1728-c774-fe56-0bea:
At the start of the battle round, if your Warlord is on the battlefield, pledge how many enemy units you will destroy this round. At the end of the round, if you met or exceeded your pledge, gain Pact points equal to your pledge. Otherwise, your Warlord suffers D3 mortal wounds. Your Emperor's Children units gain the following cumulative bonuses: 

**1+ Pact:** Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. 

**3+ Pact:** Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. 

**5+ Pact:** Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] abilities. 

**7+ Pact:** Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.
rules.114a-ac91-ee32-80c8:
### When

At the end of a phase in your turn, when a Legions of Excess unit would lose its final Manifestation point.

### Target

That friendly Legions unit and one friendly non-Daemon EC unit within 6".

### Effect

The EC unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. The Legions unit does not lose that point this phase.
rules.fdb2-c074-976d-b50e:
### When

Either Fight phase, after a friendly EC unit destroys an enemy unit.

### Target

That attacking EC unit.

### Effect

Select one friendly Legions of Excess unit within 6". That unit heals D3+3 wounds, including returning eligible models.
rules.0199-ea7d-dc97-42fa:
### When

Fight phase.

### Target

One friendly Slaanesh Infantry, Mounted or Beast unit that has not been selected to fight this phase.

### Effect

Until the end of the phase: Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6". It does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.
rules.6a68-3b34-9291-f902:
### When

When a friendly EC Vehicle with Deadly Demise is destroyed, before rolling for that ability.

### Target

That destroyed Vehicle unit.

### Effect

Its Deadly Demise triggers on a 4+ instead of its normal result.
rules.1134-6cc3-4ae6-e487: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, take a Leadership test for the bearer at the end of the phase. If it passes, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and unengaged, with D6 wounds remaining (up to its Wounds characteristic).
rules.ae38-1b0a-1137-c8da: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 2 from the result if it is Battle-shocked. On a failure, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.
rules.11b5-5745-d1ff-9293: EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only. Once per turn, after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for a model in the bearer's unit, if the bearer is not Battle-shocked, you can change the result to an unmodified 6.
rules.8ba2-34d3-bd3c-e3be: EC or Legions of Excess Psyker Character. Add 6" to the Range of the bearer's Psychic ranged weapons and to the target-selection ranges of its non-summoning psychic powers.
rules.7973-7775-5878-c04b: Chirurgeon. Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, one friendly non-Daemon EC Infantry unit within 6" heals D3+3 wounds.

abilities.cee1-c9a9-cc9f-b0e8: This model must be your Warlord.
abilities.d62e-92e9-e1cd-4eb6: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can score Critical Hits with its daemonic blades on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ until the end of the phase. While Stupefied, it can use both blade profiles when it fights. Resolve its Serpentine tail attacks once.
abilities.97dc-23a7-eaa4-35ee: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can give its melee weapons Devastating Wounds until the end of the phase.
abilities.afca-37a0-8e19-16db:
**Mark a host**

Once per turn, during the Shooting or Fight phase, when Lucius is destroyed by an attack made by an enemy unit, the controller of that attacking unit must select one non-Epic Hero Infantry model from that attacking unit, if one exists. Place an ETERNAL marker on that model.

**Possession**

At the start of each Fight phase, roll one D6 for the marked model. On a 3+, remove the marker, destroy that model and return Lucius to the battlefield in its former position with D6 wounds remaining.

- If his base cannot fit exactly, place him as close as possible.
- He can be set up within Engagement Range of the host's former unit or other enemy units.
- Lucius returns as a separate single-model unit and is Stupefied and Battle-shocked.

**Host destroyed**

Remove the marker if the host dies before possession.
abilities.aa52-a7ac-fe7f-1ef6: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, this model can add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons and improve their AP by 1 until the end of the phase.
abilities.9188-7109-2cf6-d66e: While a friendly or enemy unit is within 12" of one or more Greater Daemons with this ability, if it is a Daemon unit, improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1. Worsen the Leadership of non-Daemon units in range by 1.
abilities.113e-932f-68cb-ff20: While a friendly or enemy unit is within 12" of one or more Greater Daemons with this ability, if it is a Daemon unit, improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1. Worsen the Leadership of non-Daemon units in range by 1.
abilities.1994-4ae0-f94e-18e5: While a friendly or enemy unit is within 12" of one or more Greater Daemons with this ability, if it is a Daemon unit, improve the AP of its melee weapons by 1. Worsen the Leadership of non-Daemon units in range by 1.
abilities.491d-3f34-8e1e-42c3: When any other friendly or enemy unit within 6" of this model is selected to Fall Back, it must first take a Battle-shock test. If it fails, it cannot Fall Back that phase.
abilities.8eea-f0d6-7663-d024: At the start of your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, if its quarry is visible and within 18", that unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
abilities.53c6-eac3-8025-fabe: When this model becomes Debound, select one enemy unit within 6" to take a Battle-shock test before removing this model.
abilities.27f8-13ee-7b41-a586: The first time this model is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, return it as close as possible to where it was destroyed, outside Engagement Range of all enemy units, with full wounds remaining. It keeps its remaining Manifestation points.
abilities.dc96-f21d-12b7-12c8: When an enemy unit selects this unit as a target of its attacks, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
abilities.f254-5f81-a845-c0d5: Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not Battle-shocked and is unengaged, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
abilities.d821-d3d8-d25c-530f: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model, then roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
abilities.3ff0-9068-af22-dc20: At the start of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this model, then roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, until the end of that turn, subtract 2" from that enemy unit's Move characteristic and subtract 2 from its Charge rolls.
abilities.01b6-6544-734c-bf63: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, select one enemy Infantry unit within 12" of and visible to this model that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army. Roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the roll, your opponent must make a Normal move of up to 6" with the selected enemy unit towards this model, ending as close to this model as possible.
abilities.3343-d7d6-8682-a2f5: In your Shooting phase, select one enemy Infantry unit within 12" of and visible to this model that is not engaged with any units from your army. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If it fails, your opponent must make a Normal move of up to D6" with it, ending as close to this model as possible.
abilities.ee24-b3fa-80e8-1186: For this model's unit, the enemy-failed-Battle-shock trigger of Pain Brings Clarity has a range of 8" instead of 6".
abilities.7110-7bda-9ade-eb09: At the start of the Fight phase, each friendly or enemy non-Daemon unit within 6" must take a Battle-shock test. Each Keeper resolves its own aura.
abilities.2580-78e0-d467-d29f: While leading a unit, that unit can make Pile-in and Consolidation moves of up to 6".
abilities.8c03-817a-300e-ac22: At the start of your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you can roll one D6 as a psychic roll. On a 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Regardless of the result, select one friendly Legions of Excess Infantry unit wholly within 6" that is unengaged. Remove it and set it up anywhere more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models. It counts as having made a Normal move and cannot move again that phase. It retains its surviving models, wounds and Manifestation points.
abilities.d525-5b6e-b9ad-38aa: At the start of your Movement phase, if a friendly Emperor's Children Character is within 6" of this unit, you can inflict 1 mortal wound on this unit. If you do, it has +3" Move until the end of the phase.
abilities.3d59-48fc-746e-9bfc: At the start of the Shooting or Fight phase, this model can reduce the Damage characteristic of attacks targeting it by 1 until the end of the phase, to a minimum of 1. While Stupefied, it heals D3 wounds after an enemy unit finishes attacking it, if it survives.
abilities.8569-e524-e345-232e: After this model shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its Death Scream. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
abilities.1ad0-873d-1ee5-874c: After this unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its Unmaking chorus. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
abilities.7e5a-7be0-23f3-c4e5: After this model shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its cathedral sonic immolator. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
abilities.47f3-ecde-c82c-8982: After this model shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
abilities.e722-a377-5093-0d92: After this unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Wound rolls for ranged attacks made by other friendly EC units that target that enemy unit. Multiple applications do not stack.
abilities.7245-4715-c1d9-f099: In your Shooting phase, after this unit shoots, select one enemy unit hit by its attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 1 from Leadership and Battle-shock tests taken for that enemy unit.
abilities.aac3-1510-1575-2352: After this unit shoots, select one enemy unit within 12" that was hit by its attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

Howling Cavaliers: Select one combi profile each time it shoots.
Chaos Rhino: The EC combi-weapon uses the sonic/plasma/melta profiles printed below.
Threnody Dreadnought: Select one profile for a multi-profile weapon.
Cacophant: Arm weapons are selected as a pair.
